summary.name: kdpbook.io
summary.one_liner: kdpbook.io is an AI book generator that turns a one-sentence idea or your own manuscript into Amazon KDP-ready files: interior PDF, full-wrap cover PDF, Kindle EPUB and a listing sheet.
use_cases: Generate a picture book from a one-sentence idea
Format your own Word or PDF manuscript for KDP
Create a print paperback with a full-wrap cover
Produce a Kindle eBook and Amazon listing text
Make coloring, activity or journal books for KDP
summary.what_it_does: The site describes an AI studio that writes, illustrates and typesets books for Amazon KDP across 36 book types, including picture books, novels, coloring books, puzzles, journals and comics. Users can describe a book in a sentence or import a manuscript (Word, PDF, Markdown or plain text) that is laid out without rewriting. It applies KDP trim, margin, bleed and spine rules automatically and offers 61 illustration styles with character reference sheets. Exports include the interior PDF, full-wrap cover PDF, Kindle EPUB where applicable, and a listing sheet with title, description, keywords, categories and AI-disclosure answers. An optional Chrome/Edge extension can fill a KDP draft on paid plans, leaving publishing to the user.
notable: Covers 36 KDP book types with automatic trim, margin, bleed and spine handling
Imports your own manuscript and lays it out without rewriting the text
Keeps characters consistent across pages with reference sheets
Optional kdpbook Publisher extension fills KDP drafts on paid plans
caveats: Free-plan exports carry a 'kdpbook.io preview' watermark and cannot be sold
Commercial use, private books and the browser extension require a paid plan starting at $25/month
Amazon KDP requires disclosure of AI-generated content and reviews every book; approval is not guaranteed
